messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content: Here are some fun true or false questions you can use to introduce your new teacher に the class. These are designed to be lighthearted and fun. 1. The teacher has a favorite 食べ物 that they love more than pizza. (True) 2. The teacher once won a spelling bee in 小学校 (False) 3. The teacher can speak more than one language fluently. (True) 4. The teacher's favorite 色 is blue. (False) 5. The teacher has been to a safari once and saw a large 動物 in the wild. (True) 6. The teacher graduated from a university in another country. (False) 7. The teacher has 訪れた more than five different countries during their entire teaching career. (True) 8. The teacher's very first 仕事 was at a restaurant. (False) 9. The teacher plays a musical instrument. (True) 10. The teacher's 双子 is their favorite sibling. (False) Tip: fill in the answers with the teacher!
